We found no association between the perioperative use
of MRI and LRR in women undergoing BCS for DCIS. In
addition, no association between MRI and LRR was found
in the subset that did not receive RT. In the absence of
evidence that MRI improves the surgical management or
long-term outcomes for these patients, the routine peri-
operative use of this test should be questioned.
